photos.alt: Tall glowing paper lanterns in orange, yellow, green and pink line a night street under strings of festival bunting while people stroll toward the lit end of the road.
photos.notes: Wide cinematic night street. Lanterns fill the left third, the right half is dark street and sky with small bunting: put the headline right or lower-right with a 40-55% dark scrim. Landscape about 4:3 (1200x878), crops to 16:9 at 30% 50%.

photos.alt: A vendor in black gloves plates chaat at a counter lined with bowls of green chutney, sev, peanuts and yogurt.
photos.notes: Warm, well-lit counter shot with gloved hands only, no face. Good for the Chaat stall card; square crop at 45% 60% keeps the plate and chutney bowls.

photos.alt: Market shelves stacked with red and ivory bangles beside gold tassels and necklaces against a red wall.
photos.notes: Saturated red and gold, Chandni Chowk bazaar. Works as a Crafts and bangles stall card or a strip behind the vendor-call section; no people, no legible signage.

photos.alt: Hands wearing bangles and colourful sleeves meet in a starburst of painted dandiya sticks during a Navratri dance.
photos.notes: Radial composition centred on the stick tips: ideal for a round or circular crop, or a garba section banner. Anonymous hands, no faces.

photos.alt: Multicoloured fireworks burst across a black night sky above a silhouetted crowd watching.
photos.notes: Shot at a Bonfire Night display (UK) but reads as any fireworks finale. Near-black corners take text well; keep the burst centred, crowd silhouettes stay at the bottom edge.

photos.alt: Close view of a coloured-powder rangoli on the ground: a yellow medallion with a magenta flower and green leaves, ringed by white scrollwork and big green petals.
photos.notes: Sharp, saturated top-down-at-an-angle crop of a real powder rangoli, no people. Portrait 3:4; the flower medallion sits right of centre, so crop square or 16:9 at 62% 45%. Grey pavement shows only along the top edge.

photos.alt: A little girl in a floral dress holds two sparklers at night in a lane strung with fairy lights, with small diyas glowing at her feet.
photos.notes: Portrait 2:3. Small full-length figure, face is modest in size. Crop 4:5 around the sparklers; the fairy lights frame the top, so keep text at the bottom or to the side.

photos.alt: Overhead view of a white box of assorted Indian sweets: almond-flaked barfi, creamy sweets topped with pistachio, pink coconut-dusted rolls and golden laddoo.
photos.notes: Tight, evenly lit overhead mithai box with almonds and pistachios; no people, no brand names or text. Landscape 3:2: works as the Sweets stall card or the gift-box call-out; crops cleanly to 4:3 or square.

photos.alt: A painted clay diya in pink, green and gold sits among marigold petals and pink flowers.
photos.notes: Portrait close-up, shallow depth of field. Decorated diya reads as hand-painted; ideal for the diya-painting workshop card. Crop square at 50% 60%.

photos.alt: Strings of fairy lights stretch across a market lane at night with red paper lanterns hanging beneath them.
photos.notes: Second hero candidate: soft, blurred Delhi market lane, lights across the upper half, calm dark lower half for headline text. Landscape 3:2.

photos.alt: Terracotta pots beside a wicker basket and a wide bowl heaped with small unlit clay diyas in warm sunlight.
photos.notes: Detail/texture shot of clay diyas and pots for sale. Crop to landscape at 50% 70% for a crafts or diya-stall band; very warm, pairs with saffron palettes.

photos.alt: Two children bend over a long row of small lit diyas set along a wall at night.
photos.notes: Atmosphere shot for the aarti and diya-lighting moments. Children seen mostly in shadow and profile; dark top-left and bottom edges take text.
